Legal · Updated October 2026

Terms of use

These terms govern your use of this website. They are not the terms of a booking — those are agreed separately, in writing, with the relevant owner or agency.

Privacy policyCookie policyTerms of use

The website

This site presents a curated portfolio of properties and information about the Invenio platform. We work to keep it accurate, but availability, rates, photography and descriptions can change. Nothing on this site is an offer capable of acceptance.

A property is confirmed only when a written booking confirmation has been issued and the agreed deposit has been received.

Use of the site

You may view, download and print pages for your own use. You may not scrape the site, reproduce the photography, copy the portfolio for a competing service, or use the site in a way that interferes with its operation or security.

The Invenio name, logo and the design of this site are protected. Photographs are used with permission and remain the property of their owners.

Bookings and third parties

Bookings are made with the owner or the agency that represents the property, under their terms. Invenio may act as an agent or as a platform; the booking confirmation will make the contracting party clear.

We are not responsible for the availability, accuracy or performance of third-party websites linked from this site.

Liability

To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss arising from use of this website. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited under Spanish law, including liability for fraud or for death or personal injury caused by negligence.

Governing law

These terms are governed by Spanish law. If you are a consumer, you may also rely on the mandatory protections of the law in your country of residence. Disputes will be heard by the courts of Ibiza, unless the law requires otherwise.

Contact

Questions about these terms: find@inveniohomes.com · Invenio Homes S.L., Santa Eulària des Riu, Ibiza.
